Command line

The athena command (athena --help). Most commands take --data-dir to point at a different data folder.

CommandWhat it does
serverun the server in the foreground
start, stopstart or stop the server in the background
service install|uninstall|statusregister Athena to start automatically, or remove it
doctorcheck the host and the server, and print what's wrong
admin reset-passwordset a new password for an account
config path|show|check|resetfind, check or reset athena.json
https status|offshow HTTPS settings, or turn HTTPS off
restorerestore Athena from a backup
openapiprint or write the API schema

Run athena doctor first when something doesn't work.
